title: Chapter 2949 - 176: Straw Dog Life Skill
content:
Chapter 2949: Chapter 176: Straw Dog Life Skill

A streak of astonishment in the ashen eyes even swept over a thread of panic and complex killing intent.

Yet this thread of killing intent was completely dispelled in Mo Hua’s cold and authoritative eyes.

The "Iron Skill Bone" slowly stood upright, losing some of its wooden demeanor, gaining more of the vicissitudes of time, but his attitude was still as respectful as ever.

He bowed to the exalted Mo Hua and said, "Taoist Friend..."

The "Iron Skill Bone" continued, "No... I should call you... Divine Blessing..."

Mo Hua made no comment, looking down at the "Iron Skill Bone."

"Divine Blessing... When did you notice?" the "Iron Skill Bone" asked.

Mo Hua said calmly, "All reality and illusion cannot be hidden from the eyes of the Divine Lord."

The expression of the "Iron Skill Bone" showed some uneasiness.

Mo Hua asked him, "Why do you follow me?"

The "Iron Skill Bone" bowed and said, "Dare not deceive Divine Blessing, I was trapped in the Land of White Bones, not knowing the years on the ground, nor the situation of this Barbaric Wilderness, so I borrowed this body to come up and take a look..."

Mo Hua said, "Why do you follow me?"

This question was the same as before, but the "Iron Skill Bone" knew that Mo Hua’s inquiry was different.

"That day at the White Bone Tomb we met, it could be considered a chance of the Heavenly Dao. I saw Divine Blessing, whose divine power is extraordinary, and in the future will surely become the supreme being, accomplishing great feats, thus my Shugubu could be reborn; therefore, I intentionally divided a thread of Remnant Soul to secretly follow the Iron Skill Bone, ’assisting’ you by your side..."

The "Iron Skill Bone’s" tone was sincere, with abundant praise in his words.

Mo Hua’s expression remained indifferent, showing neither joy nor anger.

The "Iron Skill Bone" lowered his head, not daring to speak freely anymore, evidently fearing to provoke Mo Hua’s displeasure and invite some mysterious Divine Way disaster.

With Mo Hua’s current power, if he chose a name to explode the ancestor’s tomb of the Shugubu, it is estimated no one would dare object.

After some time, Mo Hua’s tone finally softened a bit and said, "You said... you are here to assist me?"

Seeing Mo Hua’s attitude less cold than before, the "Iron Skill Bone" secretly breathed a sigh of relief and clasped his hands:

"Yes, now the Shugubu falls under Divine Blessing’s command."

"As an ancestor of the Shugubu, I naturally should serve Divine Blessing and devote myself to the magnificent endeavors of the Divine Lord."

Mo Hua nodded and directly asked, "The skill you studied is the Causality Skill?"

The "Iron Skill Bone’s" gaze deepened slightly and he nodded, "It is."

Mo Hua’s alabaster finger gently tapped on the golden jade shaman’s seat, his cold gaze contemplating:

"If someone uses cause and effect to harm me, how should I avoid it?"

The "Iron Skill Bone" replied, "In the ancestor’s Causality Skill heritage of the Shugubu, there are indeed some ways to avoid cause and effect, such as the Bone Heart Transfer Skill, Bone Disaster Inducing Skill... The old I also know a thing or two, but forgive my bluntness, they are likely of no use to Divine Blessing..."

Mo Hua’s eyes slightly contracted, and his face showed authority without anger.

"The Iron Skill Bone" shuddered inwardly, immediately said, "What I speak is true, dare not deceive Divine Blessing."

Mo Hua’s face turned cold, "Then you... are of no use."

Before his words fell, a golden light flashed in Mo Hua’s eyes, containing astonishing sword aura.

The "Iron Skill Bone" looked horrified and immediately said, "There is use! I have other clues!"

Mo Hua withdrew the divine glow from his eyes and said blandly, "Speak."

The "Iron Skill Bone" gradually calmed, slowly breathed out, pondered for a moment, and said with a heavy voice:

"Bone Heart Transfer Skill, Bone Disaster Inducing Skill... These are considered top inheritance in Shugubu, can transfer disaster and avoid ominous signs, guide fortune and misfortune."

"I have spent a lifetime researching them, and indeed have gained some insights, but these methods ultimately can only avoid the ’common’ danger of cause and effect..."

The "Iron Skill Bone" glanced at Mo Hua, smiled bitterly, "Not to deceive Divine Blessing, but if these ways to avoid cause and effect were truly powerful, the first thing I would avoid is you, this ’great danger’. You would never have seen me, and from the start, would never have entered the White Bone Tomb..."

"These skills cannot help me avoid you, this ’danger’, naturally cannot help you avoid those you also deem ’dangerous’..."

"So if I pass them on to you, it would merely be wasting your time with these ’trivial skills’, without providing much assistance..."

"However, there is a heritage that should be able to aid you..." the "Iron Skill Bone" slowly said.

Mo Hua asked, "Which heritage?"

"Surely you recall, I mentioned before... our Shugubu ancestors have other ’Cause and Effect Transfer’ spell points." the "Iron Skill Bone" said.

Cause and Effect Transfer...

Mo Hua’s eyes slightly contracted.

"This Cause and Effect Transfer Skill is a tribal secret from ancient times, even in the old days, I was not qualified to take a glimpse. After all..."

The "Iron Skill Bone" sighed, "Although I’ve been dead so long, calculated by years, now considered a ’ancestor’ of the tribe, the title sounds grand. But back then, I was only one of the tribe’s upper echelon, an Elder with some talent, trapped at Golden Core Peak, unqualified to touch the true secrets..."

"The utmost secret among them is naturally this... Ancient Cause and Effect Transfer Skill... so secret that back then, I didn’t even know its name..."

"So..." Mo Hua said calmly, "now you’ve ’come back to life’ by borrowing the Iron Skill Bone’s body to return to the present world to seek this ’absolute secret’ heritage you weren’t even qualified to see before?"

The "Iron Skill Bone’s" face changed, with some unease and bitterness, said, "Divine Blessing is wise, indeed everything cannot be hidden from you."

"Among us Taoists, what truly captivates us for a lifetime, are only these Taoist Skills and Spell Points."
